Container.Name: CraftControl-Daemon
Container.Overview: CraftControl Worker Daemon Node Agent for managing containerized Minecraft instances on unRAID.

Config.Name: Daemon Port
Config.Description: HTTP REST API and WebSocket Port for CraftControl Panel communication

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Mount host Docker socket to enable Minecraft server container management

Config.Name: Minecraft Server Data Directory
Config.Description: Host directory for persistent Minecraft server worlds, configs, and modpack files

Config.Name: Daemon Bearer API Key
Config.Description: Bearer Token Key for Web Panel authentication

Config.Name: Daemon Port Env
Config.Description: Internal environment variable for daemon server port

Config.Name: Host Server Data Path
Config.Description: The path on THIS machine where the Minecraft Server Data Directory above is mapped, with /servers on the end — that subdirectory is where the daemon keeps them, so both it and the game containers name one directory. Game server containers bind-mount it directly. Without it every world is stored in a named Docker volume, which lives inside the Docker vDisk — a fixed-size file shared with all your container images. A modpack or two will fill it, and a full Docker vDisk stops Docker writing at all and takes the rest of the server down with it.

Config.Name: FRP Server Address
Config.Description: The IP address of the main server hosting the FRP Server

Config.Name: FRP Server Port
Config.Description: The port of the FRP Server

Config.Name: FRP Token
Config.Description: The authentication token for the FRP tunnel
